weaponProps.effect: You can make a Weapon Attack treating this weapon as a Projectile with a range of 3-10 by throwing it. It is then removed from your inventory and must be retrieved to be used again.

items.name: General Purpose Item
items.desc: A simple, low-value utilitarian item. You decide what it is the first time you use it.

items.name: Tongue Rope
items.desc: King Titus III’s tongue, ripped out of his mouth by the crocodile man. Treat this item as 10 ft of rope.

items.name: Traveler’s Feather
items.desc: Value: 600 A colorful feather that looks like it belonged to a mid-sized bird. It seems to be stirred by the breeze even when there is no air current present. Effect: (attunement required) You always know where the feather is as long as it is within 100 mi of you, through a psychic directional pull. You can expend 1 charge to cause the feather to return to your location if it is within 100 mi of you. You can expend 1 charge and 3 AP to send the feather to a location that you can picture within 100 mi. If you touch a being (alive or dead) with the feather, you can expend 2 charges and 10 AP to cause it to float in the air. On your verbal command, it will retrace the path the being took over the last 24 hours, stopping wherever it stopped and waiting for your command to continue. Once it reaches the last place the being was 24 hours ago, the effect ends. The effect ends after 24 hours if it has not reached its destination. If it is blocked from reaching its destination by a physical obstacle, it will attempt to circumvent it and return to its path; if unable to do so, it will simply fly in a small circle until the effect ends or the obstacle is removed. While active, it has 1 HP, 8 FD, 27 DA, and 0 AC. If it is reduced to 0 HP, it loses the haunted property. Regains 1 charge every 18 hours.

weaponProps.effect: You can only attack with this weapon if it’s armed; you may spend an action to arm it for 5 AP. Attacking with this weapon expends 1 crossbow bolt. You can make a Weapon Attack at half or double range with disadvantage to hit. Disadvantage to hit if used with one hand.

abilities.name: Prepared For the Worst
abilities.desc: You start with 3 general purpose items instead of 1.

abilities.name: Scrapper
abilities.desc: Once per round, you have advantage to hit any combatant that hit you since the end of your last turn.

abilities.name: Highly Capable
abilities.desc: Roll 2 abilities; you are treated as though you have both of them instead of this ability until you are reincarnated.

character.appearance: Short old man. 4 hairs on his head, does not shave them, turkey neck, retired hr manager, speaks in corporate talk. Retired for 40 years. Has a walker.
character.backstory: Worked for the same company since 22, HR the entire time, learned corporateise as if it were a second language, hates Karen from Finance because she fought for better pay for the employees, thinks his boss is the Second Coming.
